procedure: Bind the audience, user structure and accepted arguments.
Order claims by reader decision needs and argument dependencies.
Assign scoped section questions, exhibits, qualifications and coverage.
Return the outline and missing/conflicting argument work.

acceptance.expectation: Section IDs resolve to current argument/metric IDs; the coverage map accounts for each material accepted argument and unresolved issue.
Order, titles, exhibits and transitions serve the specified expert decision and requested structure rather than a universal TOC.
Qualifications remain adjacent to affected claims; event relationships, proposal status and fictional mode survive editorial organization.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
